title: Seam verification gate
what_it_does: seam-stamp.mjs writes the seam tweens from a ledger and seam-gate.mjs measures, per cut, whether velocity carries across it, using headless Chrome over raw CDP; zero npm dependencies.
when_to_use: Checking that cuts do not kill momentum.
why: Unique check. NOT run here: the script pins HyperFrames 0.8.14 (line 41), so bump HYPERFRAMES_VERSION to 0.9.67 and test before shipping. It spawns `npx hyperframes@<version>` and may download.
